# Inventory Manager

Version: 1.3.0-beta. Free Beta: tested with example data; feedback welcome.

> Free, open-source reorder planner: what to buy, how much, by when. Offline; your data stays on your device. Python standard-library engine/CLI, Hermes Desktop plugin (JS mirror of the engine), offline single-file HTML page. Read-only data sources; nothing places orders.

## Start here
- [README.md](README.md): what it is, try it, quickstart
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what exists vs roadmap, commands, invariants
- [CONTEXT.md](CONTEXT.md): package contract and folder routes
- [docs/AI-GUIDE.md](docs/AI-GUIDE.md): task recipes (map ERP fields, dry run, change a column)
- [docs/GUIDE.md](docs/GUIDE.md): full reference (settings, CLI, CSV import, Odoo, Desktop plugin, number rules)
- [docs/release-notes/v1.3.0-beta.md](docs/release-notes/v1.3.0-beta.md): current beta safety warnings, limits and feedback

- [docs/architecture/MCP.md](docs/architecture/MCP.md): implemented read-only local MCP: startup, tools, safety and client configs; draft/write extensions remain proposed

## Data
**Missing-data gates.** Missing incoming supply stays unknown in source data and exports, but purchase estimates assume 0 incoming; check existing orders before buying. Missing or invalid stock or sales holds advice (at least 3 complete sales months are required). Missing supplier lead time uses the configured fallback (14 days by default, marked `used_default_lead`); clearing that fallback without another valid lead holds purchase advice, not the physical forecast. A supplied source lead of 0 is valid. Invalid supplied incoming holds advice.

- [docs/data/CONTRACT.md](docs/data/CONTRACT.md): canonical CSV bundle contract v1.0 (the input every source must produce)
- [docs/data/ORDER-BUILDING-SPEC.md](docs/data/ORDER-BUILDING-SPEC.md): order ledger, capability gates, signed offline proposals (spec)
- [docs/data/AR-GLOSSARY.md](docs/data/AR-GLOSSARY.md): Arabic terms (draft)

- [docs/erp-examples/](docs/erp-examples/): synthetic example exports from eight ERPs

## CLI input review
- Every single-CSV `python3 stock_runway.py stock.csv` invocation prints an `Input meaning: {…}` JSON report to stderr, even without interpretation flags; canonical `--bundle` validation is separate.
- `--show-orders-anyway` acknowledges reported risks after checking the file; it does not repair invalid data. Do not auto-add it in scripts.
- `--stock-includes-reserved` subtracts a recognised reserved/allocated column and warns if it is absent; incompatible with `--strict`.
- `--incoming-not-in-file` ignores incoming in this file, retains `incoming_unknown` and counts it as 0, with a warning to check open POs; separately supplied dated receipts remain.
- Both interpretation flags are for single CSV files, not `--bundle`. Exit 0 means export succeeded; exit 2 means input review needs acknowledgement (including a latest sales month still in progress) or an argument/input/output error occurred. Read stderr to distinguish them.
- [docs/GUIDE.md](docs/GUIDE.md#input-review-and-acknowledgement): acknowledgement thresholds, flag rules and output streams.
- [docs/WHY-THIS-AMOUNT.md](docs/WHY-THIS-AMOUNT.md): `--explain`, `--json`, two-decimal display rounding (up to six places for fractional target precision), explicit `[display rounding]` term, exact JSON ledger.
